// diagnostic

E1305

field `name` has no CLI flag mapping (Type)

What

field `name` has no CLI flag mapping (Type)

Why

Only `Int` (including inline ranges), `Float`, `Bool`, `String`, `Path`, and `T?` of those map to a flag; a nested `#CLI` struct, a `Map`, a closure, or a plain `[T]` don't.

Fix

change the field to a supported type, or drop it from the `#CLI` struct.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1305: tests/ui/cli_field_unsupported_type.stderr.

Error [E1305]: field `names` has no CLI flag mapping ([String])
  --> tests/ui/cli_field_unsupported_type.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     names: [String]
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: a `#[CLI]` field becomes one `--flag` (and a positional when required); only `Int` (including inline ranges), `Float`, `Bool`, `String`, `Path`, and `T?` of those have a defined shape (nested `#[CLI]` structs and other collection/closure types don't).
 Fix: change the field to a supported type, or drop it from the `#[CLI]` struct
